Ask about your chats…UnreadAgreementsRepliesSearch

Less busywork in your chats

Keep track of agreements, help customers and keep your groups useful. Ask your agent to work through Telegram and MAX.

Personal accountContext, decisions and reminders

Connect your own account, just like adding another device. Access your chats, history, groups, channels and contacts.

Unread messages in one place.See incoming messages without marking them as read.
Keep track of agreements.Review what you and others have promised since your last check-in.
Find it, even with a typo.Search your local chat archive by full words, partial words or approximate spelling.
News from your subscriptions.Ask your agent for a digest of the channels you follow, on the topics you choose, with links to the posts.
Voice notes as text.Transcribe with Telegram or a speech model running on your computer.
Send later.Telegram delivers your message on schedule, even when your laptop is closed.
How to use your account →
BotsPersonalisation, customer support and broadcasts

All Bot API methods. Every method of the official Telegram and MAX Bot APIs is exposed through the CLI, alongside simple commands for messages, files and chat administration.

Group broadcasts.Ask your agent to send an announcement to the groups and channels you choose.
Personalised messages.Let your agent tailor each message using the customer details you provide.
Replies with context.Give your agent a knowledge base or conversation history to help it answer customer questions.
Team notifications.Keep people informed about requests, results and changes, with the files they need.
Buttons and clear choices.Help people choose an action, open a link or respond with a tap.
Control what gets sent.Choose who the bot may contact and check which sends succeeded or need attention.
How to set up a bot →
Groups you runModeration, answers and community health

Keep your community useful: unanswered questions, clear decisions and conversations that follow your rules.

Question monitoring.Find questions left without an answer so members get the help they came for.
AnalyticsWho joined, left, was added or removed, and who did it.
Keep discussions on track.Ask your agent to flag spam, insults and conflicts so you can step in early.
Moderation by your rules.Choose which violations to flag, which messages to delete and when to remove a participant.
Discussion summaries.Get the decisions, open questions and next steps without rereading the whole conversation.
Group management.Delegate routine invitations, admin changes and invite-link updates to your agent.
How to run a group →

Telegram and MAX, one search

Find messages across both. Bring agreements and files together from your saved history.

tgTelegram

A Telegram client for your terminal and AI agents, using your own account.

npm i -g @leemour/tg-cli
DocsGitHubnpm
maxMAX Messenger

Connect your MAX account or use your bots through the official Bot API.

npm i -g @leemour/max-cli
DocsGitHubnpm

Why it works this well

Built for agents and scripts: fast, predictable and easy to audit.

Fast
Search runs on the copy of your chats on your computer. No network, no waiting.
tg messages search "contract" --offline
Runs everywhere
Windows, macOS and Linux with Node.js 22 or later. No native modules to compile.
npm i -g @leemour/tg-cli
Powerful search
Find messages even with typos or incomplete words. Search across chats and channels, narrow results by sender or date and recover the surrounding conversation.
tg messages search "contract"
Local storage
Your chat history stays in a local cache on your computer. Search it offline, create backups and restore your archive when needed.
tg store backup · tg store restore
Flexible permissions
You control what your agent can do: read only, run allowed commands or ask your permission before an action.
permissions.messages.send · --confirm-send
Always up to date
A background service keeps your local history up to date and syncs missed messages after a restart.
tg server install
Multiple accounts and bots
Switch easily between accounts and bots. Keep work and personal conversations separate, or ask your agent to gather context from several accounts.
tg work inbox
Action history
Check send attempts in the journal and record command runs when needed. Logs keep IDs, statuses and timings, without message text.
tg sends list · tg runs list · --record
Secure
Secrets stay in the system keyring. Passwords, login codes, phone numbers and tokens do not leak into logs or command history. Protection against prompt injection helps prevent chat messages from steering your agent.
tg session start

A day with your agent

A few moments with your agent. The rest of the day is yours.

08:00

Start with the essentials

Get one short summary of the chats that need your attention.

11:00

Prepare for a meeting

Bring together the relevant messages before the conversation starts.

15:00

Keep things moving

Reply to a request or follow up with someone you are waiting for.

19:00

Finish with a clear picture

See what was resolved and what needs attention tomorrow.

Continue the conversation with the full context

Choose Telegram or MAX. The guide takes you from installation to your first answer.

Start with Telegram →Start with MAX →
